card.name: Digits inside numbers in tables
card.fires_on: Mostly a digit or space partway through a number, such as the 0 before a decimal point in dosing tables or the 2 in a count like 220. Also fires on a few scattered words before a quantity or phrase.

modes.label: Digits in numeric tables
modes.description: The leading 0 or a digit in a decimal value within rows of numbers in a dose chart.

modes.label: Counts in running text
modes.description: A digit inside a larger count in prose.

modes.label: Scattered linking words
modes.description: A space, bracket or small word just before a number or phrase.
